what: On first open, two greeting lines (”Welcome.” / ”Where your story together begins.”) sit hidden on the background-color panel, each letter 1rem down and transparent. After .5s the first line floats up with a slight overshoot, letter by letter at .04s intervals over .5s back.out. The second line follows .1s before the first one ends, at .02s intervals. At 3.5s the panel fades out over 1s and fx:done fires. If the visitor returns within 30 minutes, there is no text and the panel alone fades out over 1s (original cookie 30 minutes).

options.each: Letter spacing per line (seconds, comma-separated), default .04,.02
options.hold: Time when the panel starts to disappear (s), default 3.5
options.every: Minutes until shown again, default 30 — 0 means always

use:
Welcome.

To the place where your story begins.
note: Fires fx:start when the text is shown — stopping smooth scroll and freezing the hero video is up to the consumer (resume on fx:done)

from.where: index.html loading (original Top — .js-loading p two lines of letters opacity · y 1rem → .5s easeOutBack stagger .04 · .02, 3.5s fadeOut 1s, cookie lastExecuted 30 min)
